d: Senior DMK leader and Rajya Sabha MP Tiruchi Siva stated that DMK President M.K. Stalin convened a meeting of party MPs to address large-scale voter roll deletions under the Election Commission of India's SIR process. According to Siva, nearly one crore genuine voters were deleted in Tamil Nadu alone, including one lakh voters in Stalin's constituency. He alleged that the Chief Election Commissioner acted unilaterally without consulting fellow election commissioners, who raised objections multiple times in writing.
